title: A Study of Baricitinib (LY3009104) to Preserve Beta Cell Function in Children and Adults Newly Diagnosed With Type 1 Diabetes (BARICADE-PRESERVE)
official: I4V-MC-JAJK: A Phase 3, Double-Blind, Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Study of Baricitinib to Preserve Beta Cell Function in Participants Newly Diagnosed With Type 1 Diabetes Aged ≥1 to <36 Years
summary: Main objective: To demonstrate the superiority of baricitinib versus placebo in the preservation of β-cell function, as measured by C-peptide, in younger adult and pediatric participants with new-onset type 1 diabetes after 52 weeks of treatment.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Have a new diagnosis of type 1 diabetes
2. Have at least one protein in the blood (called an autoantibody) that is associated with diabetes at screening
3. Weigh at least 8 kilograms (18 pounds) at screening
Exclusion criteria:
1. Have any other type of diabetes
2. Have uncontrolled high blood pressure
3. Have had a heart attack, heart disease, stroke, or heart failure
4. Have a history or high risk of blood clots or certain types of cancer
5. Have a current or recent serious medical condition or infection
